name: Track crop, vineyard, grain and livestock records through the season
summary: Keeps the season record for crop, vineyard, grain and livestock farms: reads fields, sessions, recent records, animal counts and rainfall from AgriWebb, flags what the record is missing, and queues each rainfall reading for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every write to the farm record.

covered_by.record-operations: not covered (AgriWebb's API has no crop-operation write, and the business's logging tool is not in the kit)
covered_by.harvest-yield: not covered (FreshTrack bin scans are not in the kit)
covered_by.review-report: draft (the review flags missing crop types, stale records and rainfall gaps into the store)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (snapshots and reviews kept in the workflow store)
covered_by.plan-season: draft (fields and their crop types read from AgriWebb, checked by the review)
covered_by.weather-soil-data: approval (rainfall readings queued for a person to approve; soil data not covered)
covered_by.livestock-movements: not covered here (the livestock NVD build covers movements and NLIS)

crons.name: collect
crons.summary: Read each watched farm's fields, sessions, recent records, animal count and rainfall from AgriWebb into the store.

crons.name: review
crons.summary: Flag what the season record is missing (no recent records, fields with no crop type, no rainfall) from the last read.

crons.name: queue-records
crons.summary: Queue each new rainfall reading for approval. Nothing is written to AgriWebb until a person approves it.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. Nothing here writes to AgriWebb on a cron. mutation.addRainfalls is a live operation: a cron only queues it, and it runs when a person approves it.

agriwebb.covers: farm, field, session, record, animal count and rainfall reads; rainfall writes queued for approval

gaps: Crop operations (sprays, fertiliser, cultivation, pruning, harvest) have no write in AgriWebb's API: its record writes cover animal records only (purchase, weigh, observation, group change). Crop operations are read here, not logged.

agworld (record-operations, compliance-records, review-report and record-keeping rated yes on the platform file): no kit platform folder, so nothing is read or drafted through it. Owners on Agworld keep their records there.
innovint (compliance-records and storage-stock rated yes): no kit platform folder and no mapped operations.
FreshTrack (harvest bins scanned at the packing shed): not in the kit, so harvest-yield is not covered.
CropX (soil and sensor data) and the business's operations centre: not in the kit.
AgriWebb's rainfall write needs the rain gauge sensorId (mapFeatures, type RAIN_GAUGE). The agent or owner must enter it on each proposal; the adapter does not look it up.
AgriWebb sign-in: bearer token from AGRIWEBB_ACCESS_TOKEN only. The token exchange is not built (platform.json), and no live account has been tested.
Judgment stays with the agent and the owner: reading field notes, deciding what a flagged field needs, and choosing which rainfall readings to enter.
Pre-harvest checklist and livestock movements are outside this build.
